open_points.subject: operation_element_conclusion / reach_operation_element after a not_applied resolution
open_points.text: - operation_element_conclusion: [DETERMINISM_OR_ORDERING] Decides from the latest NodeExecution of the element, the one with the highest attempt_number, in this order: succeeded concludes succeeded with that record's outputs; outcome_unknown with its EffectAttempt applied concludes succeeded with no outputs when the binding has no output ports and otherwise failed with status outcome_unknown and detail applied_outputs_unknown; any status other than succeeded, service_unreachable and outcome_unknown concludes failed with that status and detail_code; then an approval of the element with status requested makes it wait with reason owner_approval and that approval_id; then outcome_unknown with its attempt unknown waits with reason outcome_unknown; then service_unreachable waits with reason service_unreachable; otherwise — no NodeExecution, or a latest outcome_unknown whose attempt the owner resolved not_applied — the element is not reached, so it is reached again when its node is next taken, and after not_applied its send needs a fresh approval (find_send_authority), which reach_operation_element requests (decision 32).
open_points.other_text: - reach_operation_element: [BEHAVIOR] When find_send_authority returns None MUST, unless an approval of the element with status requested already exists, write one RequestApprovalChange for the element with the binding_id, input_digests, the prepared request_digest and an ApprovalPreview of the operation's service_id, operation_name and effect_class, the prepared request description and the element's input PortRefs; input_digests are the digests of every input value and file in input port name order, list elements in list order. Nothing is sent and the element waits with reason owner_approval for that approval, the existing requested one when there was one, even if its request_digest differs.
open_points.question: After a not_applied resolution, must reach_operation_element always request a fresh approval, or must it reuse any existing requested approval even when that approval predates the resolved attempt or has a different request_digest?
